summary: Lint, build, diff scope and content changes verified and the projects layout is clean at both viewports, but the AI Talking Avatar copy claims a cinematic intro video that the live site does not play today. Rejected on that unsupported claim (a work-item constraint forbids invented claims); the fix is a one-line copy change. Findings: F1 medium content-writer (blocking); F2 low frontend-dev; F3 low content-writer.

criteria.criterion: The AI Talking Avatar claim of a cinematic intro video is checked against what a visitor actually sees: components/avatar/IntroVideo.tsx plays only when NEXT_PUBLIC_INTRO_VIDEO_URL is set, so QA states whether the live site at https://liutsko.me plays the intro video today and flags the claim as a finding if it does not.
criteria.evidence: Live site https://www.liutsko.me (liutsko.me 308-redirects to www) loaded in the Playwright MCP browser, also with ?intro=1: accessibility snapshot has no skip-intro control and no video element; fetched HTML and all referenced JS chunks contain no intro-video-seen string and no .mp4/.webm. So the live site does NOT play the intro video today, and the repo has no NEXT_PUBLIC_INTRO_VIDEO_URL set in tracked files. The new AI Talking Avatar copy 'a cinematic intro video that hands off to a real-time 3D avatar' is therefore not what a visitor sees. Flagged as finding F1 (medium). Evidence limit: the live deploy may predate the intro-video merge, but a visitor today sees none.

criteria.criterion: QA states approve or reject with every finding given a severity and an owner.
criteria.evidence: Verdict rejected; findings F1 (medium, content-writer) blocking, F2 and F3 (low) non-blocking, each with owner below.

assumptions: Changes are uncommitted in the worktree; the diff was read from the working tree against origin/master 4b886a8.
Worktree git status was identical before and after QA (status1/status2 diff empty).
decisionsProposed: F1 fix options for the Boss: (a) reword entry 8 to drop the intro-video clause, e.g. 'This site: a real-time 3D avatar you can talk to...'; or (b) keep it only if NEXT_PUBLIC_INTRO_VIDEO_URL is set in the Vercel deployment shipping this PR, then QA re-verifies on the deployed URL. Findings: F1 medium owner content-writer, blocking: intro-video claim unsupported on live site (data/index.ts entry id 8). F2 low owner frontend-dev, non-blocking: Apex Mind card has about 110px empty gap above icon row at 1440 because grid rows stretch to the E-commerce card; optional. F3 low owner content-writer, non-blocking: retained legacy claims not in live-site text (tenant-private, private/frontier model routing, Startup Weekend award, GSAP + Lenis); user-supplied pre-existing, confirm with user. F4 info owner Boss: gridItems in data/index.ts is dead data, the Node.js edit there has no visible effect; visible stack comes from persona skills.
lessonsProposed: Copy that describes a feature gated by an env var must be checked against the deployed site, not the repo, since the code can be merged while the feature is off.
